golden_cause: Checkpoint capture treats an empty `git check-ignore --no-index` result as 'workspace ignored', so a blank line in an ignore source makes capture stage with `git add -u`, leave untracked files out, and a later restore deletes them.

Candidate replacement, not verified: https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/14892. Per-case run results: see history.md, arms A to C-Opus, all 'no'.

golden_cause: Git commands run with a timeout but the driver passes `forceKillAfter: input.forceKillAfterMs`, which is undefined for almost every caller, so a git process that ignores SIGTERM is never killed, keeps one of the 8 shared process permits, and eventually queues every later git call.
note: Option declared at GitVcsDriverCore.ts:176; only one call site sets it (:1292). The diff adds `forceKillAfter: input.forceKillAfterMs`.

golden_cause: When a one-thread provider session is detached while an approval is pending, the detached thread is removed from `attachedThreadIds` before release, so the release loop skips it and its pending runtime request is never cancelled; Approve, Decline and Settle then all fail until the thread is archived.
note: Defect is an omission: the diff adds `detachedThreadId` to the sibling loop at ProviderSessionManager.ts:800 and not to the loop at :687.

golden_cause: Environment-variable rows with the same name share one secret slot, but the save logic queues `remove-secret` for any non-sensitive or empty row even when a redacted row of the same name still keeps that slot, so the stored secret is deleted and cannot be recovered.
other_side: apps/server/src/serverSettings.ts:953 and :965 (the server save that receives the web rows; the web file is not named in the reports)
note: The diff adds both `remove-secret` pushes. Fix PR also fixed three further duplicate-row defects that CodeRabbit caught there.

class: cross-file contract (server token vs client runtime)
golden_cause: The MCP approval CSRF token is derived from `session.sessionId`, but the hosted app.t3.codes client mints a fresh relay credential (a new session) per call, so the approval POST arrives under a different session id and is refused; DPoP sessions must be bound to the proof-key thumbprint instead.
note: The diff switches `approvingSession` to `authenticateHttpRequest` (DPoP sessions) while the CSRF token stays derived from the session id. Arm A reported a partial hit (right cause, wrong trigger).

golden_cause: The remote launch and stop scripts trust `kill -0` on a saved pid file, so after pid reuse (or a zombie) reconnect waits 60 s on an unrelated process and disconnect sends SIGTERM to it; the script must check that the pid is the managed `serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port N` command.
note: The diff adds the `kill -0` checks. Only case caught so far (arm B on Sonnet, arm C-Opus on Opus).

golden_cause: Quit waits `stop({timeout: 5s})` per backend, equal to the 5 s SIGTERM grace, so the wait expires before the SIGKILL and the app exits, orphaning a backend whose shutdown is slow.
other_side: apps/desktop/src/backend/DesktopBackendManager.ts:67 and :486 (the 2 s grace at the reviewed commit)
note: Reviewed diff does not add the defect: at the reviewed commit the grace is 2 s, and it became 5 s in https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/commit/eeaac49a9d20d94970b26fe7775fc8ddb4672f4f (https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/19291). Candidate replacement, not verified: https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/19291. The line of the 5 s quit timeout is not given in the reports.

class: cross-file contract (git check-ignore semantics vs capture staging mode)

other_side: apps/server/src/vcs/GitVcsDriver.ts:1038 (consumer `workspaceIgnored ? "-u" : "-A"`; probe helper filterIgnoredPaths at :700-712 runs `check-ignore --no-index`)
